newsitem.title: ITALY: Alitalia looking at question of surcharge.
newsitem.headline: Alitalia looking at question of surcharge.

text.p: Italian national carrier Alitalia is looking into the question of a possible cargo rate surcharge due to the steep rise in jet fuel prices but no decision has been taken yet, a company spokeswoman said.
"We are studying the question as clearly this affects all the air cargo business, but no decision has yet been taken," she said.
Both KLM and Swissair announced on Tuesday they were raising their cargo rates and Lufthansa did so last Friday.
